btcdeb.what_for: Write, compile, run and step through Bitcoin Script, check real signatures against transactions, and try Taproot constructions. For learning and debugging, not wallets.

steps.text: Recognized the skill: btcdeb
Runs the spend with its real transaction context
Shows sighash and signing details
Records exit status, error, final stack and assumptions separately
Finishing without error isn't spend validity, and a --pretend-valid run is never signature verification.
Shows the failing opcode and stack, with a plain explanation and the assumptions used.

demo.result: You see where verification fails, e.g. a missing input amount for witness signature hashing.

caveats: Exit status 0 can still leave false or an empty stack; completion isn't spend validity.

Won't remove verification flags or enable disabled opcodes just to make a spend pass.

Which NAPs does a DM inbox napplet need?
Design a note composer that still works as a tiny widget.

Which domains should my bookmarks napplet require, and which stay optional?

steps.text: Recognized the skill: napplet-design
Maps each feature to a shipped NAP: lists for list edits, outbox for reads, storage for state
Splits hard requires from optional domains, each with a fallback
Plans the tiny, compact, regular and wide tiers plus whole-surface theming
Anything that needs fetch, localStorage or signing inside the napplet gets redesigned or flagged as a gap.
Hand this spec to napplet-build?

demo.result: A spec block: napplet type, NAPs used, requires, fallbacks, tiers, theme, states and data flow.

caveats: Writes no app code; the output is a spec for napplet-build.
relay is only a named escape hatch; social reads and publishes go through outbox.
Every NAP is voluntary, so each optional domain gets a named fallback.

steps.text: Recognized the skill: napplet-ui
Looks for the three usual bugs: a title header, a centered website column, one tested width
Replaces the page layout with a full-frame root, compact tokens and container-query tiers
Applies the theme's background, text and primary to html, body and root, with a fallback palette
If it looks the same at 600px and 2400px it isn't done; wide frames get more rows, columns and detail.
Run the four-frame check in dark and light?

Checked at four frames (200×160, 320×560, 900×600, the largest) in dark and light themes.

Scaffolds from the boilerplate
Sets the d-tag, title and description
Lays out the frame per napplet-ui, then wires @napplet/sdk calls in src/main.ts
Builds the single file and runs conformance
No fetch, localStorage or external images; bytes go through resource, state through storage.
Open a runtime preview through Paja?

napplet-sdk.what_for: Write napplet code against the domains @napplet/sdk actually ships: outbox for reads and publishes, social NAPs, storage, read-only identity, resource bytes and theme, with fallbacks for optional domains.
prompts: How do I load a user's last 20 notes in my napplet?
Show an avatar in my napplet without fetch.

Add a react button that hides when the shell has no common domain.

Count reactions on a note without downloading them.

steps.text: Recognized the skill: napplet-sdk
Picks outbox, because relay choice affects which notes come back
Writes an outbox.query with authors, limit and timeoutMs, and reads each result.event
Uses only current option fields: no strategy, no subscribe live, no outbox.eose
identity.getPublicKey() returns an empty string when signed out, so the code shows a signed-out state.
Add this query to src/main.ts?

caveats: Uses only the domains the installed packages ship; anything else is flagged as a gap.
The installed @napplet/sdk types, not the examples, are the source of truth for signatures.
identity is read-only; there is no signing, encryption or window.nostr.
relay is only for relay-local needs that outbox and the social NAPs can't express.
napplet-sdk.needs: A napplet project with @napplet/sdk installed; its installed types are the source of truth

napplet-interop.what_for: Connect napplets: broadcast with NAP-INC topics, ask the shell to route actions with NAP-INTENT, and advertise archetype roles such as napplet:note/open in the manifest.
prompts: Open a profile in another napplet when I click an author.
Make my napplet the handler for napplet:note/open.
Broadcast the selected profile to sibling napplets.
Why does my inc.on subscription never fire?
Handle intent deliveries in my profile viewer.

steps.text: Recognized the skill: napplet-interop
Uses the queryless convention napplet:profile/open
Dispatches intent.open with the pubkey in the payload and checks ok
In the profile napplet, records the archetype role
Acceptance isn't delivery; the target validates the payload in intent.onDelivery.
Add the handoff to both napplets?

demo.result: Clicking an author asks the shell to open that profile in a napplet that advertises profile/open.

caveats: Topics and conventions match exactly; subscribe to the queryless identity, never a queried one.
Every received payload is untrusted and gets validated before use.
An accepted intent means the runtime took the request, not that delivery finished.
inc and intent stay optional; the affordance hides when the domain is absent.
napplet-interop.needs: A napplet project with @napplet/sdk; a design spec that names the cross-napplet feature

Inventories each feature and the browser authority it uses today
Maps relay pools to outbox, window.nostr signing to shell publishes, localStorage to storage
Splits the monolith into focused napplets: feed, composer, profile, DMs
A leftover relay client, signer, direct network layer or site header means the boundary is still wrong.
Hand the port inventory to napplet-design?

relay stays only for a named relay-local escape hatch.

steps.text: Recognized the skill: napplet-migrate
Confirms this is an event conversion preview, not a project rebuild or a publish
Verifies the signature and writes an unsigned preview
Reviews the author, kind and d identifier, description, and required versus optional domains

Review done. Publish the new manifest as a separate step?
